                         THE MINI BHARATIYA NAGARIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023
                                      NO. 1 OF 2023
An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Criminal Procedure.
      BE it enacted by Parliament as follows:—
                                      CHAPTER I
                                       PRELIMINARY
Short title.          1. (1) This Act may be called the Mini Sanhita.
                      (2) It extends to the whole of India.
Definitions.          2. (1) In this Sanhita, unless the context otherwise requires,—
                                  (a) "bail" means release of a person from custody upon
                      certain conditions;
                                  (b) "charge" includes any head of charge.
                      (2) Words not defined here have the meanings given elsewhere.

     Sec. 1]                             THE GAZETTE OF INDIA
     ___________________________________________________________

                                      CHAPTER II
                                  BAIL AND BONDS
Bail where the        3. (1) A person accused of a minor offence shall be released on bail:
offence is not
serious.               Provided that the Court may refuse bail for reasons to be recorded.
                      (2) The Court may impose conditions on the bail.
                      Illustration.
                      A is accused of a minor offence. A is released on bail.
Saving of other
law.                  4. Nothing in this Sanhita affects any other law.
